**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

My dear [Miss Smith](../persons.html#263)
Thank you much I will keep the story for the final selection. I think the mistake is excellently done, but I am not sure that the girls’ taking the journey on purpose to defy Mr Ritchie is not too dreadful.
I am so glad you have brought out Dulcibella again[^2]

yours sincerely

C M Yonge

[^1]: Envelope with violet engraving on flap addressed to Miss Carter Smith/ Thistleworth/ Stevenage and postmarked Winchester (date cut out) and Stevenage 17 January 1883.

[^2]: CMY seems to refer to two stories by Carter Smith here: a story for the Christmas number which does not seem to have been chosen, and \'The Tramp of Many Feet\', which was in course of serialization in the [Churchman\'s Companion](../others.html#62).
